results.title: Space Ops: Record 263 Orbital Launches Attempted In 2024 | Aviation Week
results.content:
SpaceX’s record year pushed U.S. orbital launch activity to a total of 145 flights in 2024, compared to 109 attempts in 2023.
The U.S. tally includes five flights by United Launch Alliance, which conducted its final Delta IV mission in 2024 along with two Atlas V and two of its new Vulcan rockets.
